**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**

The Green Transit Alliance (GTA) is proud to announce the winners of our annual Green Transit Awards. As the urgency of the climate crisis grows, public transit agencies are on the front lines of reducing carbon emissions.

For this year's awards, the GTA evaluated US transit agencies by combining data from the National Transit Database (NTD) and the Energy Information Administration (EIA). We analyzed millions of unlinked passenger trips (UPT) and passenger miles, cross-referencing them with local fuel consumption and state-level electricity emissions.

Award 1: Most Emissions Avoided

This award recognizes the agency that saved the most total pounds of CO2 compared to if all their passengers had driven individual gas-powered cars.

```{r}
load("my_data.RData")
knitr::kable(avoided_tbl, caption = "Top Agencies by Total Emissions Avoided (lbs)")
```

MTA New York City Transit leads the nation by avoiding millions of pounds of CO2.

Award 2: The Electrification Leader

This award celebrates the agency with the highest percentage of electric propulsion compared to traditional combustion fuels.

```{r}
knitr::kable(electrification_tbl, caption = "Top Agencies by Electric Ratio")
```

The Regional Transportation Commission of Washoe County leads the nation with an electric ratio of over 97%.

Media Supplements (Visualizations)

Supplement A: Top 5 Greenest Agencies

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
agency_efficiency |>
  filter(total_co2 > 0) |>
  slice_min(co2_per_pm, n = 5) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(AGENCY, -co2_per_pm), y = co2_per_pm)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Greenest Agencies", subtitle = "Lowest CO2 Emissions per Passenger Mile", x = NULL, y = "CO2 per Passenger Mile (lbs)", caption = "Data Source: NTD & EIA") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

Supplement B: US Public Transit Fuel Mix

```{r}
NTD_ENERGY |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Gallons of") | starts_with("Kilowatt hours"), names_to = "Fuel_Type", values_to = "Amount") |>
  group_by(Fuel_Type) |>
  summarize(Total_Used = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  filter(Total_Used > 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Fuel_Type, Total_Used), y = Total_Used)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Total Fuel Used by US Public Transit", subtitle = "Aggregated across all agencies", x = "Fuel Type", y = "Total Amount (Gallons or kWh)", caption = "Data Source: NTD") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
